policy_recommendation: Resolve preserved copied documents only through reviewed SHA256-bound source-context mappings; add the original archived README root context.
Use Git-selected paths or a clean checkout for public availability checks; workspace existence alone cannot establish public availability.

Permit absent-by-design status only for the 63 exact reviewed paths in this report, including twelve raw registry witnesses. Report those separately from available evidence. New exclusions require source-role review.
Require current navigational targets and viewer resources to exist in the public checkout. Include the two reviewed authored HTML outputs or revise their current README navigation explicitly.
Keep local reproduction checks distinct from public package checks. Public structural success does not mean excluded corpora, scans or witness-dependent analyses can be rerun from the checkout alone.
Retain frozen document bytes, source notices and the two exact public-history quarantine decisions. Do not exempt whole ignored extensions or accept a candidate list without classification.
provenance_observations: The nineteen new Lipi examples are purpose-limited, individually attributed excerpts retained outside any licence for original project material. Their publication decision should remain explicit in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

The site-map deck contains only hash-matched PNG derivatives declared CC BY 4.0 Helsinki1979 by assets/ASSETS.json and carrying in-document title/authors/CC BY attribution. No archaeological photograph or unlicensed sign font was found in these HTML outputs.
Site-map and deck depend on public Google Fonts and Leaflet CDN resources. This review checks authored output bytes and resource references, not external network service availability.
The HF Parquet candidates are licensed generated release products kept local by packaging choice. Describe them separately from unresolved-rights corpora when listing excluded inputs.

The existing ASSET-REVIEW.md preservation/history prose describes a planned isolated filter before its completion. Final release status should link actual history verification and remote visibility evidence after those steps.
limitations: The review classifies exact navigation candidates and inspects the two HTML output asset sets; it is not a full re-audit of every reachable historical blob.
Zero matches in the stated patterns is bounded signature screening. Arbitrary strings and undisclosed third-party rights are not certified.
